model_assumptions.capex: Annual cash capex20–28B assumes moderation from nine-month2026 cash purchases23.558B (31.4B annualized) while maintaining contracted delivery. This is a key unverified assumption, not the37–39B2026 management capital-expenditure measure, which is not directly interchangeable with cash capex. All forecast capex includes replacement and growth; separate components unknown.
model_assumptions.equity: Each scenario assumes entire35M ATM authorization issued in2027 at analyst issue prices30/40/50, less2%fee, plus15.5M annual vesting from existing31M RSU/RSA pool. Issue prices are financing stresses, not targets. Proceeds reduce debt needs; dilution is not charged again in FCF. Conversion remains debt; new financing and employee grants beyond those assumptions absent.
model_assumptions.funding: Q4 cash capex9B approximates observed Q3 cash purchases9.441B; other cash uses300M are an explicit reserve. Expected9B customer funds: bear receives4.5B in2027, base6B inQ4 plus3B2027, bull9B inQ4. These are modeled new cash receipts, not verified receipts or additive revenue. Each period subtracts20% of recognized revenue as assumed recognition of prior prepayments; the20% is the midpoint of historical15–25% active-contract prepayments disclosed for2023–25, NOT a verified2027 recognition ratio. Opening deferred revenue10.002B is used solely as the assumed prepaid liability pool and rolled forward. No additional recurring new customer prepayments are credited after2027; cash receipts could therefore differ materially. Cash minimum3B is analyst liquidity reserve, not covenant. Rate7–10% applied to average gross debt is an aggregate cash-cost sensitivity anchored to Q4 interest guidance annualized4.2–4.6B versusSep principal47.505B; not facility coupon or current market yield.
model_assumptions.operating_costs: Observed Q3 adjusted EBITDA margin61.62%; Q3 PPE depreciation approximately1.9B is about52% of revenue. Scenario margins53–63%, D&A35–48% of revenue and SBC2.5–4% are explicit scale/efficiency stresses; historical Q3 SBC160M/3661M=4.37%. Lower future D&A ratios require revenue growth relative to deployed asset depreciation, not a proven equipment-life extension.
model_assumptions.revenue: Base assumes23,000M in2027;2028=(47,628−4,836−23,000)/0.75=26,389.333M, using uniform2028 recognition within the first9months. Bear recognizes80% of disclosed initial24-monthRPO:2028=(47,628×0.8−4,686−18,000)/0.75=20,555.2M. Bull25,000/30,000M implies4,986+25,000+0.75×30,000=52,486M throughSep2028,4,858M above the old47,628M schedule; this explicitly requires incremental contracts/acceleration. These allocation assumptions are NOT issuer FY2027/28 forecasts.
model_assumptions.valuation: Normalized unlevered cash conversion20/35/50% of adjusted EBITDA, return15/12/10%, growth0/2/3% are independent economic assumptions. Base/bull conversion requires large improvement from Q3 adjusted operating-income/EBITDA ratio~16.8%, after considering replacement/tax/working-capital demands. No quote, tactical price range or peer multiple is used to choose them. Because replacement economics are unverified, outputs are transparent sensitivities, not an endorsed fundamental target.

models.method: Adjusted EBITDA=R×margin; EBITDA=adjusted EBITDA−SBC (other EBITDA adjustments assumed0). D&A=R×D&A ratio; SBC=R×SBC ratio. Pretax=adjusted EBITDA−D&A−SBC−interest; tax=25%×max(pretax,0); net income=pretax−tax (simplified GAAP-style forecast, not issuer adjusted net income). FCF=adjusted EBITDA−cash interest−cash tax−cash capex+customer receipts−prepaid revenue recognition (20%×R), with other working-capital changes assumed0. Equity proceeds=new ATM shares×assumed issue price×98%. New debt=max(0,3000−opening cash−FCF+scheduled principal−equity proceeds). Ending debt=opening debt−scheduled principal+new debt. Interest=rate×average opening/ending debt, solved iteratively; cash=opening cash+FCF+draw+equity proceeds−principal. Shares include assumed vesting/issuance, no automatic conversion.
